overview_description.description:
Property Finder is a digital real estate platform in the Middle East and North Africa region, connecting property seekers with verified listings across various markets, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Qatar, Bahrain, and Turkey. It delivers an online real estate marketplace where users can browse, buy, rent, or invest in residential and commercial properties via its web and mobile applications.
The company offers specialized tools for professionals, including myCRM Pro for managing leads and client interactions with API integrations, Data Finder for real-time analytics and market insights, Lead Tracker for monitoring customer engagement and pricing, Mortgage Finder for tailored mortgage guidance, and Online Masterclass for digital education in real estate.

product.name: Property Listings Platform
product.description: An online platform for listing, searching, and managing real estate properties for sale and rent in the MENA region.

product.name: Live Viewings
product.description: A virtual property viewing service enabling remote, real-time property tours via the Property Finder platform.

product.name: PF Flex
product.description: A credit-based subscription service allowing agents to activate and manage property listings with flexible package options.

product.name: Single Use Premium Listing
product.description: A service offering one-time premium property listing placements to increase visibility on the Property Finder platform.

product.name: CRM Integration Service
product.description: A service enabling third-party real estate CRM providers to publish property data on Property Finder via XML feeds.
